status_rules.finished_perfect: Only an owner explicitly listed status=finished_perfect in a completion ledger merged on main can be removed from remaining_to_perfect.
status_rules.started_open_pr: Owner is explicitly referenced by a non-source-only open implementation PR inside postal canton 1000.
status_rules.started_main_runtime: Owner is explicitly referenced by production game/runtime files on main but has no finished_perfect ledger entry.
status_rules.source_registered_main: Owner is persisted in data/urbis or belongs to merged C01, without a started implementation or finished_perfect marker.
status_rules.source_draft: Owner belongs to active C02 source-only draft and is not production source truth.
status_rules.unstarted: Owner belongs to the locked LoD2 missing planner but has no production source registration or implementation marker.
status_rules.unresolved: Official 1000 building owner cannot be reconciled with locked LoD2/repository evidence and remains fail-closed rather than guessed.
